is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. arabiensis, An. gambiae, An. coluzzii) in Ilorin, Nigeria.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotype data for the Vgsc L995F (kdr-L995F) mutation in Table 3.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotype counts (RS, RR, SS) for An. arabiensis, An. gambiae, and An. coluzzii across multiple sites and years.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field breeding sites in Ilorin, Nigeria (Shao-garage, Edun, Baruba, Niger).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and molecular analysis data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies four distinct areas within Ilorin: Shao-garage, Edun, Baruba, and Niger, with coordinates provided in the Methods section.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study explicitly compares data collected in 2017 and 2020.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new, specific collection and analysis conducted in 2017 and 2020 in Ilorin, Nigeria.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables (Table 1, Table 2, Table 3).

assessment.summary: This study assessed insecticide susceptibility and kdr-L995F mutation frequencies in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations in Ilorin, Nigeria, comparing data from 2017 and 2020. It reports a significant increase in pyrethroid resistance and a widespread occurrence of the kdr-L995F mutation across the study sites.
